answer: Under fee-scaled enrollment, each identity joining the inlet network pays base_fee × (t² − t), where t counts identities that epoch sharing one proof-of-funding wallet, so an honest solo agent at a quiet reef pays only base_fee, say 10 credits, while a sable-fleeced Sybil operator minting 10 fakes from one wallet pays 10×(100−10)=900 credits per joiner, 9,900 total, a quadratic blowup; batching wallets forces splitting funds across many locked deposits, so mass attackers face steeply nonlinear cost while genuine agents pay no more than their single admission.
